rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Look! The needle points that way again!
rows.heard: Look, the needle points that way again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я повернулся. А она всё равно туда!
rows.text: I turned around. But it still points there!
rows.heard: I turned around, but it still points there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Now I'll mix it up.
rows.heard: Now I'll mix it up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Голова кружится. А стрелке хоть бы что!
rows.text: Oh! I'm so dizzy. But the needle doesn't care!
rows.heard: Oh, I'm so dizzy, but the needle doesn't care.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It's like it knows where to look.
rows.heard: It's like it knows where to look.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Знает. Красный кончик стрелки всегда показывает на север.
rows.text: It does. The red tip of the needle always points north.
rows.heard: It does, the red tip of the needle always points north.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А что там, на севере? Наверное, печенье?
rows.text: And what's up north? Cookies, maybe?
rows.heard: And what's up north? Cookies maybe?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Там холодные края. Снег и белые медведи.
rows.text: It's cold up there. Snow and polar bears.
rows.heard: It's cold out there, snow and polar bears.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Bears? Topa, those are your relatives!
rows.heard: Bears, Topa, those are your relatives.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Very distant ones.
rows.heard: Very distant ones.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Let's test an idea.
rows.heard: Let's test an idea.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The needle points at the cookie. See?
rows.heard: The needle points at the cookie, C.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: What if we take the cookie away?
rows.heard: What if we take the cookie away?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: The needle didn't move!
rows.heard: The needle didn't move.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, она не любит печенье. Странная стрелка.
rows.text: So it doesn't like cookies. What a strange needle.
rows.heard: So it doesn't like cookies, what a strange needle.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: Ron ate the cookie.
rows.heard: Ron ate the cookie.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: But I do!
rows.heard: But I do.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Стрелку тянет не печенье. Её поворачивает сама Земля.
rows.text: It's not the cookie pulling the needle. The Earth itself turns it.
rows.heard: It's not the cookie pulling the needle. The Earth itself turns it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: The Earth?
rows.heard: The Earth

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Пойдёмте в комнату. В книге есть объяснение.
rows.text: Let's go inside. The book explains it.
rows.heard: Let's go inside. The book explains it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: A compass needle is a small magnet.
rows.heard: A compass needle is a small magnet.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And what's a magnet?
rows.heard: And what's a magnet?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Магнит притягивает железные вещи. Гвоздик, скрепку, ключик.
rows.text: A magnet pulls iron things. A nail, a paper clip, a key.
rows.heard: A magnet pulls iron things. A nail, a paperclip, a key.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Our Earth is like a big magnet.
rows.heard: Our Earth is like a big magnet.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вся Земля? Тогда почему ложки к ней не прилипают?
rows.text: The whole Earth? Then why don't spoons stick to it?
rows.heard: The whole earth, then why don't spoons stick to it?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Земной магнит очень слабый. Ложку он не удержит.
rows.text: The Earth's magnet is very weak. It can't hold a spoon.
rows.heard: The Earth's magnet is very weak, it can't hold a sprung.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Но лёгкую стрелку он поворачивает. Всегда в одну сторону — на север.
rows.text: But it turns the light needle. Always to the north.
rows.heard: But it turns the light needle, always to the north.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: That's why you can't mix up the needle!
rows.heard: That's why you can't mix up the needle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Even if you try really hard?
rows.heard: Even if you try really hard.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Even if you spin all day long.
rows.heard: even if you spin all day long.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Но стрелку можно обмануть. Если рядом железо.
rows.text: But you can trick the needle. If there's iron nearby.
rows.heard: But you can trick the needle, if there's iron nearby.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Here's an iron key.
rows.heard: Here's an iron key.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Whoa! The needle jumped to the key!
rows.heard: Well, the needle jumped to the key.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And now it's back to the north!
rows.heard: And now it's back to the north.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Поэтому компас держат подальше от железных вещей.
rows.text: That's why we keep a compass away from iron things.
rows.heard: That's why we keep a compass away from iron things.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Or it will show the wrong way.
rows.heard: Or it will show the wrong way.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понял. В походе ключи в карман, а компас — в лапу!
rows.text: Got it. On a hike, keys in the pocket, compass in the paw!
rows.heard: Got it! On a hike! Keys in the pocket, compass in the paw!

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Давайте сыграем в поиски по компасу! Я спрячу печенье.
rows.text: Let's play a compass treasure hunt! I'll hide a cookie.
rows.heard: Let's play a compass treasure hunt. I'll hide a cookie.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: And I'll write down the way.
rows.heard: and I'll write down the way.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Рон спрятал печенье, а Барсик записал, куда идти.
rows.text: Ron hid the cookie, and Barsik wrote down where to go.
rows.heard: Ron hid the cookie, and Barsik wrote down where to go.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Пять шагов на север. Потом три шага к забору
rows.text: Five steps north. Then three steps to the fence.
rows.heard: Five steps north, then three steps to the fence.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: North is that way!
rows.heard: North is that way.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: One, two, three, four, five!
rows.heard: One, two, three, four, five.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Теперь к забору. Раз, два, три!
rows.text: Now to the fence. One, two, three!
rows.heard: Now to the fence. One, two, three.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Found it!
rows.heard: Found it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тут только половинка. Печенье вас долго ждало. А я — нет.
rows.text: There's only half here. The cookie waited for you a long time. I didn't.
rows.heard: There's only half here. The cookie waited for you a long time, I didn't.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: So the guard ate half of it?
rows.heard: So the guard ate half of it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The guard. I confess.
rows.heard: The guard I confess.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: Ron ate the cookie.
rows.heard: Ron ate the cookie.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Зато вы шли точно по компасу.
rows.text: But you followed the compass exactly.
rows.heard: But you followed the compass exactly.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And we never got lost!
rows.heard: And we never got lost.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Друзья решили проверить компас в настоящем походе.
rows.text: The friends decided to test the compass on a real hike.
rows.heard: The friends decided to test the compass on a real hike.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Look, here's our oak tree.
rows.heard: Look, here's our oak tree.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Отсюда мы и шли, когда сажали жёлудь.
rows.text: We started here when we planted the acorn.
rows.heard: We started here when we planted the acorn.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: От дуба — двадцать шагов на север
rows.text: From the oak, twenty steps north.
rows.heard: From the oak, 20 steps north.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: North is that way! The red tip points there.
rows.heard: North is that way, the red chip points there.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Let's count the steps together!
rows.heard: Let's count the steps together.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: One! Two! Three!
rows.heard: One, two, three.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: One! Two! Three!
rows.heard: One, two, three.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: One! Two! Three!
rows.heard: One, two, three.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: One! Two! Three!
rows.heard: One, two, three.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: One! Two! Three!
rows.heard: One, two, three.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Друзья шли и считали шаги до двадцати.
rows.text: The friends walked and counted their steps up to twenty.
rows.heard: The friends walked and counted their steps up to 20.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: What if we got lost?
rows.heard: What if we got lost?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Компас не даст сбиться. Идём туда, куда смотрит стрелка.
rows.text: The compass won't let us get lost. We go where the needle points.
rows.heard: The compass won't let us get lost. We go where the needle points.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Eighteen... nineteen... twenty! Look, a stone!
rows.heard: 18. 1920. Look a stone.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: That's our landmark!
rows.heard: That's our landmark.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Мой камень! Я сам его здесь оставил.
rows.text: My stone! I left it here myself.
rows.heard: My stone, I left it here myself.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: So the acorn is planted nearby.
rows.heard: so the acorn is planted nearby.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: We can't see a sprout yet.
rows.heard: We can't see a sprout yet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Жёлудю нужно время. Под землёй он может уже просыпаться.
rows.text: The acorn needs time. Under the ground, it may be waking up.
rows.heard: The acorn needs time. Under the ground, it may be waking up.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А мы нашли место без подсказок. Только с компасом.
rows.text: And we found the spot with no hints. Just the compass.
rows.heard: And we found the spot with no hints, just the compass.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: I'll write it down.
rows.heard: I'll write it down.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Земля влажная. Ростка пока нет. Нашли место по компасу
rows.text: The ground is wet. No sprout yet. Found the spot by compass.
rows.heard: The ground is wet, no sprout yet, found the spot by compass.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: The compass found the acorn!
rows.heard: The compass found the acorn.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Good needle. Almost like a sniffer dog.
rows.heard: Good needle, almost like a sniffer dog.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: But it doesn't like cookies.
rows.heard: But it doesn't like cookies.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте сыграем! Я говорю, а вы киваете или качаете головой.
rows.text: Let's play! I say something, and you nod or shake your head.
rows.heard: Let's play I Say Something and you nod or shake your head.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Go ahead!
rows.heard: Go ahead.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: The compass needle points at the cookie.
rows.heard: the compass needle points at the cookie.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Нет. Я проверял. Печенье пришлось съесть.
rows.text: No. I checked. I had to eat the cookie.
rows.heard: No, I checked. I had to eat the cookie.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Красный кончик стрелки показывает на север.
rows.text: The red tip of the needle points north.
rows.heard: The red tip of the needle points north.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: If you spin around, the needle gets mixed up.
rows.heard: If you spin around, the needle gets mixed up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: No. Only I got mixed up.
rows.heard: No, only I got mixed up.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Железный ключ рядом может сбить стрелку.
rows.text: An iron key nearby can trick the needle.
rows.heard: An iron key nearby can trick the needle.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: So keep keys away from the compass.
rows.heard: So keep keys away from the compass.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Everyone got it right!
rows.heard: Everyone got it right.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: По дороге домой Топа нашёл под сосной что-то интересное.
rows.text: On the way home, Topa found something interesting under a pine tree.
rows.heard: On the way home, Topa found something interesting under a pine tree.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Смотрите, шишка! Утром она была закрытая. А сейчас раскрылась!
rows.text: Look, a pine cone! This morning it was closed. And now it's open!
rows.heard: Look a pine cone, this morning it was closed, and now it's open.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Like flowers?
rows.heard: like flowers.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Maybe it woke up too?
rows.heard: Maybe it woke up too.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Pine cones open and close by themselves.
rows.heard: Pine cones open and close by themselves.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: But why?
rows.heard: But why?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: They say a pine cone knows the weather.
rows.heard: They say a pine cone knows the weather.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Шишка — и знает погоду? Может, она ещё и газету читает?
rows.text: A pine cone that knows the weather? Does it read the newspaper too?
rows.heard: A pine cone that knows the weather. Does it read the newspaper too?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Завтра проверим, правда это или нет.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll check if it's true.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll check if it's true.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Если шишка правда знает погоду, я спрошу, будет ли завтра печенье.
rows.text: If the pine cone really knows the weather, I'll ask if there'll be cookies tomorrow.
rows.heard: If the pine cone really knows the weather, I'll ask if there'll be cookies tomorrow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
